name: Miami Menace
summary: Joey Hammonds has found himself in a comfy spot amidst the backdrop of 1986 Miami. As a retired man, Joe spends his days enjoying as much sun, waves and nightlife that the “Jewel of Florida” can offer him. Despite all the excitement that can come from being secured for life, Joe can’t help but to feel that a part of himself is not getting the full treatment of paradise it deserves. As the year comes to a close and the sun sets on the bay, Joe’s wish is granted in the form of a singular phone call. What happens next is an experience that ordinary men could only dream of.
